notes.title: New Release: v1.2
notes.notes:
We're proud to announce that KOTH v1.2 is now available with full support for the Oculus RIft with Touch Controllers.

We've also made the active controller swiching more dynamic so you can freely switch between controllers in game just by operating them.

Many thanks to Jay for making this release possible. He has recently joined the development team and brought some good Rift expertise.

notes.title: New Release v1.1
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce a major release to KOTH, including full support for Non-VR PCs so you can now play KOTH if you don't have a HTC VIVE.

Mouse - Look Around
Left Mouse Button - Move
A - Absorb
S - Spawn a box

notes.title: New Release v1.0r4
notes.notes:
We've been watching several new players to the game this week and holding the trackpad whilst operating the trigger / grip is sometimes proving a bit fiddly. In this release, we've changed the beam such that it is now always on which makes things much easier as you can just point to the thing you want to operate on and use the relevant control on its own. The tutorial has been updated to illustrate this.

Oh, and if no VR is detected, it will run in a new desktop mode and you can use the keyboard and mouse. (If you have VR, you can force this by setting -novr as a command line argument) This is currently in beta and not yet fully complete but if you do give it a go, let us know what you think. Feedback is always welcome.

Thanks for playing.

notes.title: New Release v1.0r3
notes.notes:
So we know the game isn't graphically stunning at the moment and we're starting to address this with this new release.

We've started with the controller beam which, fair enough, was a bit TOO retro. (In fact, we hadn't changed it from the original example code. Disgraceful, really.) We think you'll like the new, more dynamic beam.

We've continued to fight with the Steam Leaderboard API and there's also a small fix in for ensuring that if you reach a level with an empty leaderboard, it will display correctly.

That's all for this week. Thanks for playing.

notes.title: New Release v1.0r2
notes.notes:
- Menus rewritten. Main menu made more intuitive.
- Koth radar rewritten to adapt to terrain. More efficient and accurate.
- Koth radar speed computation revised slightly.
- Player name characters not in chosen font shown as #.
- Rocks look good from underneath.
- Tree trunks made (a bit) rounder.

notes.title: New Release v1.0r1
notes.notes:
A quick fix release has just been uploaded with some highscore table issues fixed.

You should be able to see the highscore table now, even if you're not on it yet.

Also, there's a quick patch in for a crash (!) caused by some strange characters in someones Steam Name (You know who you are! :D). I apologise if your name doesn't render quite right yet. This will be fixed ASAP. At least it doesn't crash anymore.

Many thanks for your patience if this was causing you problems and if you see any issues or funnies, please let us know on koth@abbeytek.com.

Cheers.
